Tooltip: Process of selects the specified user office and role in the confins R3 system. The activity fails when the specified role or office is unavailable or the expected post-selection state cannot be confirmed.

Arguments.Name: MaxRetrySelectRole
Arguments.Tooltip: Maximum number of retries process select role in confins R3. The default value is 3.

Arguments.Name: IntervalRetrySelectRole
Arguments.Tooltip: Interval in seconds to retries process select role in confins R3. The default value is 5 seconds.

Arguments.Name: Office
Arguments.Tooltip: Office in select role confins R3.

Arguments.Name: Role
Arguments.Tooltip: Job title in select role confins R3.
